meta.title: Low-code Project Mode (dsh-magical-lowcode-project)
meta.description: Low-code project mode: browse a low-code project tree inside the workspace (right-click menu: view, copy content for the AI, push/pull, pre-push lint, rename, delete), inspect page/api push status, run source-*.js project scripts, assemble a page preview sandbox, lint before pushing, and import/export Agent preset packages (.dshpreset).
